goal: Decide whether the community collector may read a UOR Foundation Discord channel for the CHAOSS Chat Platform Inclusivity metric.

app.name: uor-discord-read
app.title: Discord channel read policy
app.purpose: Permit the read-only collector to read a UOR Foundation Discord channel only when it is a text or forum channel everyone can view, the Foundation labels it public, a server administrator installed the bot and the Message Content intent is granted.

fields.name: visibility
fields.means: whether the @everyone role can view the channel

fields.name: label
fields.means: how the Foundation labels the channel for collection

fields.name: install
fields.means: whether the bot was authorized by a member with Manage Server

fields.name: intent
fields.means: whether the Message Content privileged intent is granted to the bot

meanings.permit: the collector may read the channel's messages
meanings.deny: the collector must not read the channel
meanings.not-applicable: the Foundation has not labeled the channel, so nothing is collected
meanings.indeterminate: message content would arrive empty, so no reading can be trusted

rules.why: CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md: reports arrive by direct message and are handled with confidentiality
CHAOSS Chat Platform Inclusivity counts messages and participants; the collector records no audio
Discord OAuth2 bot authorization: adding a bot to a server requires the Manage Server permission
CHAOSS Chat Platform Inclusivity measures public shared chat rooms; a channel @everyone cannot view is not public
afflom/me: no personal data leaves its owner without declassification; the Foundation excludes the channel
collection is opt-in per channel; an unlabeled channel is outside the policy
Discord Gateway: without the Message Content privileged intent, message content fields arrive empty

app.otherwiseWhy: a public, labeled text or forum channel, with an admin-installed bot holding the Message Content intent

properties.why: a restricted channel is never read
only channels the Foundation labels public are read
a bot not installed by a server administrator never reads
empty content is never counted as a reading

stakeholders.name: Discord member
stakeholders.text: Talks in the Foundation's Discord and needs to know which channels are read and that direct messages never are.

stakeholders.name: Discord administrator
stakeholders.text: Installs the bot and labels channels, and needs nothing read that was not labeled public.

stakeholders.name: Community and Outreach Committee
stakeholders.text: Needs Chat Platform Inclusivity measured on the Foundation's live chat.

components.name: Discord
components.text: The Foundation's Discord server, read through the Discord API by a read-only bot.

components.name: Perceval Discord backend
components.text: The GrimoireLab collector that asks this app before reading a channel.

threats.name: Private conversation collected
threats.text: Direct messages or restricted channels, including Code of Conduct reports, are collected.

control.name: Public channels only
control.text: Direct messages, voice and restricted or unlabeled channels are never permitted.

threats.name: Label changed after collection
threats.text: A channel is relabeled excluded after messages were collected.
threats.accepted: The app decides per read; deleting already collected messages of a relabeled channel belongs to the collector's retention policy.
